description: This header file provides helper functions and declarations for handling ASN.1 encoding/decoding of RRC (Radio Resource Control) messages in a 5G NR context, including packing messages into PDUs, filling ASN.1 structures, and extracting transaction IDs.

methods.name: pack_into_pdu
methods.description: Creates a byte buffer PDU from an RRC message, with error logging if encoding fails.

methods.name: fill_asn1_rrc_setup_msg
methods.description: Fills an ASN.1 RRC Setup structure with provided message data.

methods.name: get_transaction_id
methods.description: Extracts the transaction ID from RRC setup complete or UL-DCCH messages.

methods.name: fill_asn1_rrc_smc_msg
methods.description: Fills an ASN.1 RRC Security Mode Command message with specified algorithms and transaction ID.

methods.name: fill_asn1_rrc_reconfiguration_msg
methods.description: Fills an ASN.1 RRC Reconfiguration message with transaction ID and request data.

methods.name: fill_asn1_rrc_resume_msg
methods.description: Fills an ASN.1 RRC Resume message with transaction ID and resume request data.
